persos.desc: garba seller in her 40s, mustard-and-crimson kaba, a headscarf, holding ONE single ladle
persos.pose: standing behind the counter on the left, holding the ladle, proud

persos.desc: boy around 7, cream-and-apricot school uniform, cheeky grin, holding ONE single full plate of garba
persos.pose: standing in front of the counter in the middle, holding his full plate, grinning

dialogue: Tantie, pourquoi ce petit-là passe devant tout le monde dêh ?!
Mon vieux, lui il a fait la queue neuf mois dans mon ventre.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The man points at the boy with his free hand and protests, his face three-quarters to the camera. The boy just grins, holding his full plate. The seller rests her free hand on her belly and says her line proudly, her face clearly visible.
chute: The boy sticks out his tongue while the man stares at his empty plate. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the waiting man's speechless face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: TOUTE LA FILE APRÈS CETTE RÉPONSE :
mecanisme: logique absurde au pied de la lettre : la grossesse comptée comme temps d'attente
